thread.title: Is Pandora 'Spot On' With New Family Plan? - Pandora Media (NYSE:P)

author: Spencer Osborne
title: Is Pandora 'Spot On' With New Family Plan? - Pandora Media (NYSE:P)
text:
Pandora ( P ) has been making some bold moves ever since Sirius XM ( SIRI ) took a 20% stake in the streaming music service. Today the company announced that it has completed its acquisition of AdsWizz , a company that builds ad platforms for multiple streaming services. More quietly, the company has rolled out Premium Family , a service geared toward competing more directly with services like Spotify ( SPOT ) and Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL ).
The new Pandora Premium Family offers an advertising-free experience for up to six people for $14.99 per month. Premium Family will allow customized playlists, on-demand listening, downloads for offline listening, unlimited skips and replays, as well as better audio quality. The pricing is on par with offerings from other services such as Spotify.
The streaming music business has had its struggles with finding a way to profits. Royalty rates and even free services have made it difficult for any company to really gain traction in a manner that delivers dollars to the bottom line. In my opinion, the Pandora acquisition of AdsWizz has actually allowed Pandora to be more aggressive in the marketplace.
AdsWizz provides very targeted advertising that creates value for the listener. An ad-supported format allows consumers to access vast music libraries in exchange for advertising spots that the consumer may actually find useful. The platform also creates value for those running the ads by ensuring that a company can get its product service or idea in front of people that can and will actually use it.
Pandora announced its $145 million acquisition of AdsWizz late in Q1 of this year and at the time stated that it expected to close the deal in Q2. At the time, Pandora was trading at about $5 per share. Just 8 weeks later, this equity is flirting with $7 per share. In addition to the obvious benefits to Pandora here in the U.S., AdsWizz gives Pandora a global revenue stream. AdsWizz is active in 39 countries.
Family plans in streaming services have become more common over the past year or so. With connected homes, connected cars, and streaming on cell networks, the trouble of one person at a time being able to listen to music has gotten cumbersome for consumers. In the past, multiple individual accounts in one family have proven to be difficult to keep active. A big assist in the creation of family plans has to go to smart speakers and advancing technology that has more people listening to music in more places.
With its new features, Pandora has almost re-invented itself. Early in the life of streaming services, Pandora's music genome was seen as revolutionary. It built a service around the user's tastes and created a "station" that learned over time. As good as that technology is, instant access to a particular song or even an album was lacking. Spotify filled that need and grew to a massive size by allowing full customization. One of the critical downsides of Spotify has been that it was having extreme difficulty in making money with its business model.
Pandora has a huge benefit in having Sirius XM, and by extension Liberty Media ( LSXMA ) ( LSXMA ) in its corner. Those two companies are also attempting to make some serious moves in the more traditional terrestrial radio space. The synergies that can be created with a top tier terrestrial radio portfolio, top tier streaming services, and satellite radio can make for a pretty compelling argument that any component, or all components of such an alliance could be an M&A coup for the ages, and it is not going unnoticed by savvy sector analysts.
The bottom line is that Pandora seems to be making all of the right moves these days with confidence and without delay. The company is being decisive, and that is something that Wall Street seems to appreciate. These days, Pandora is better managed and is executing at a level that was not present in years past. This company has a new vision that is not muddied by indecision. The Pandora story will continue to be very interesting in the quarters ahead. Stay Tuned!
Disclosure: I am/we are long P, SIRI, LSXMA, LSXMK.
